summary: Single concurrency model (3 primitives) covering the offhours-gatherer manual×cloud double-fire cluster. Primitive 1 (Backstop-Window Defer Gate) fixes Root A via a new error-branch in leader-lock.md when leader-lock times out within the :00-:15 backstop window of a 4h-boundary hour. Primitive 2 (Cross-Sibling Signal Visibility Window) fixes Root B — news-scout SELF_SIGNALS_CACHE reads a 15-min shared signal-bus window query instead of empty-set. Primitive 3 (Sibling-Success Corroboration Gate) fixes Root C — market-watcher requires both 2x probe failure AND no sibling signals in 15-min window before filing gateway-down BUG. Primitives 2+3 share one get_recent_signals(window_seconds=900) helper.

tasks.action: Add Backstop-Window Defer Gate error-branch at top of task_claim block: when LEADER_CLAIM call errors/times-out AND UTC.hour ∈ {0,4,8,12,16,20} AND UTC.minute < 15 → EXIT (defer one tick). Outside that window → PROCEED. See brief §Primitive 1 for verbatim pseudocode.
tasks.ac: Simulate leader-lock tool error within backstop window → dispatcher defers (EXIT); same error outside window → dispatcher proceeds. No double-fire across manual+cloud paths.
